description: Welcome to Lunar & Martian! We are participating under theRaipurLocal Event, tackling the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars." We are combining technical, creative, and storytelling skills to highlight space exploration history. We are looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in coding, data analysis, graphic design, writing, and storytelling to join our team. Let’s build something incredible together!
summary:
The Silent Legacy is an interactive educational website, It explores five space missions: Apollo, NASA’s InSight lander, the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, NEAR Shoemaker, and the Kepler Space Telescope.

The website showcases mission hardware, explains the functions of important components, and highlights the scientific achievements made possible by these technologies. Through interactive sections, hardware images, and visual storytelling, it makes space exploration history easier to understand and explore.

Our goal is to inspire students and space enthusiasts by showing that even after a mission ends, its technology and scientific contributions continue to leave a lasting legacy.
details:
The Silent Legacy is an interactive educational website developed in response to NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 – Challenge 01, “Abandoned but not Forgotten.” The challenge focuses on telling the stories of NASA hardware left on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space, and explaining the science that this equipment made possible.

Our project presents five space missions: Apollo, InSight, Ingenuity, NEAR Shoemaker, and Kepler. Each mission section introduces the mission and its achievements, while hardware-focused content helps visitors understand the purpose and importance of the technology used.

The website uses an interactive scrolling experience, mission-based sections, visual storytelling, and expandable hardware explanations. It is designed to make complex space technology easier to understand for school students and young space enthusiasts.

The project was developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript and is hosted on Netlify. ChatGPT was used as an AI assistance tool during website development, code structuring, and editing of explanatory content.

The main benefit of The Silent Legacy is that it connects the hardware behind space missions with the scientific knowledge those missions produced. It encourages curiosity about space exploration, engineering, and scientific discovery. Its creative approach is to treat completed missions not simply as old equipment, but as important parts of humanity’s continuing journey of exploration.
